mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time < #{end} ${dataScope} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.resolve_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.resolve_time IS NOT NULL AND t.resolve_time >= #{start} AND t.resolve_time < #{end} ${dataScope} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.resolve_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name

SELECT
IFNULL(c.category_name, '未分类') AS name
CASE t.priority WHEN 0 THEN '低' WHEN 1 THEN '中' WHEN 2 THEN '高' WHEN 3 THEN '紧急' ELSE '未知' END AS name
CASE t.source WHEN 'phone' THEN '电话报修' WHEN 'wechat' THEN '微信/企微' WHEN 'onsite' THEN '现场报障' WHEN 'self' THEN '自助提单' ELSE '其他' END AS name
CASE t.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待受理' WHEN 'ASSIGNED' THEN '已指派' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN '处理中' WHEN 'SUSPENDED' THEN '已挂起' WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN '已解决' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN 'MERGED' THEN '已合并' ELSE t.status END AS name
t.status AS name
, COUNT(1) AS value FROM biz_ticket t LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = t.category_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time < #{end} ${dataScope} GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT IFNULL(t.handler_name, '未指派') AS name, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN t.duration_seconds > 0 THEN t.duration_seconds END), 0), 0) AS avgDuration FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time < #{end} ${dataScope} GROUP BY t.handler_id, t.handler_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT IFNULL(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM biz_ticket t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = t.dept_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time < #{end} ${dataScope} GROUP BY t.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created, SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_time >= #{start} AND t.resolve_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN t.close_time >= #{start} AND t.close_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('ASSIGNED','PROCESSING','SUSPENDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS suspended FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 ${dataScope}

SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.duration_seconds), 0), 0) FROM biz_ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.resolve_time IS NOT NULL AND t.resolve_time >= #{start} AND t.resolve_time < #{end} AND t.duration_seconds > 0 ${dataScope}
